Device.Name: EM1430 (32DI P/N)
EM1430 (32DI P/N)
Device.Comment: 32DI; eight optional P2n/P3n slots. AB, AB2x, AB4x, CWCCW, DIRPUL, PUL, Z; 32-bit hardware counters. One UINT16 config per slot at 8001..8008, default zero. Z pairs with AB in slots 1/2, 3/4, 5/6, 7/8 in either order; reset/latch bits belong to AB. Z uses P2, with P3 remaining an independent pulse input.
32路DI；8个默认空槽，端子P2n/P3n。AB、AB2x、AB4x、CWCCW、DIRPUL、PUL、Z，32位硬件计数。每槽8001至8008一个UINT16配置字，默认全零。1/2、3/4、5/6、7/8槽可组成AB+Z，顺序不限；清零和锁存位在AB槽配置。Z槽P2为Z、P3保留独立计数。

Object.Name: MCU temperature - Status
Object.Comment: Live temperature status: read individual subindices. Complete Access is not supported (0x06010004). Sampling and alarm processing remain continuous.

SubItem.Name: Node address (0 = unassigned; restart to activate)

Object.Name: Slot 1 P20/P30 Config
Object.Comment: UINT16, default 0. Bits 0/1 invert P2/P3; bits 2/3 select falling edges on the inverted signals (0=rising). In AB/AB2x/AB4x: bit5 resets AB and bit6 latches AB on the paired Z edge. Bits 4/7 reserved, write 0. High byte: 0=filter bypass, 1..254=nominal microseconds, 255=327.04 us. Hardware length is quantized. Apply in PREOP or on PREOP to SAFEOP.
